# M0 Demo

Run: `npm run dev -- --port 5173`

Default watch: http://127.0.0.1:5173/?seed=4471&speed=4

War demo: http://127.0.0.1:5173/?&speed=4

Watch for this:
- Opposing blue and violet trail corridors from corner nests into the same front.
- A border-clash toast and ring when the vanguard dies on the contested food.
- The rival feeding itself from its own bushes instead of surviving on a drip.
